description: Live run-tool E2E tool list for the Tilemap Tools extension. Driven by tests/e2e/run_tool_e2e.py from the e2e-godot CI leg against a connected headless editor + a local gamedev-mcp-server. Each entry is one real assertion: a regression in the tool turns the CI leg red.
notes: Every tilemap-* tool resolves its TileMapLayer relative to the edited scene root, so the 'setup' phase opens a Node2D scene first via the core godot_mcp 'scene-create' tool (TileMapLayer is a 2D node). 'tilemap-set-tileset' is NOT asserted here because it needs a real .tres TileSet resource in the testbed; add one (and a set-tileset entry) in iteration 03 if you want it covered. set-cell stores cell data independent of the TileSet, so get-used-cells reflects it without one. The 'expect' substrings are matched against godot-cli's compact --raw JSON (PascalCase field names from TileMapLayerInfo).
